whyRerun: promotion-prep.md itself records that the gate scripts are not part of any regression run and broke silently three times (stages 2a/3/4). The recorded '12/12 passed' was a 2026-09-09 snapshot, so the gate was re-executed instead of trusted.

Duplicate matrices drift: recommend collapsing to a single source of truth.

found.rootCause: Same stale requirement: the compatibility pin demanded that app.post('/api/chat/stream') exist in server/index.js.
